title: 電気回路Ⅱ（先取り履修・オンデマンド授業）
subtitle: Electric Circuit II
keywords: Electric power, Maximum electric power problem
educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire basic knowledge of AC in electrical circuits and develop the ability to analyze AC circuits through physical and mathematical considerations. It deals with basic circuits of resistance (R), inductance (L) or capacitance (C), which are a review of "Electrical Circuit I", to slightly complicated application circuits that combine them. Here, students will learn the circuit analysis method by the symbolic method and acquire the basics of the advanced analysis method required in the subsequent "Electrical Circuit III".
advice:
1.	Phasor of a complex number and symbolic method of AC circuit
2.	Series and parallel connection of complex impedance and complex admittance
3.	Phase condition problem in series-parallel circuit
4.	Series resonant circuit and parallel resonant circuit
5.	Calculation of the electric power, complex electric power and maximum electric power problem by symbolic method
books: Basic electric circuit(2nd edition)New Edition, Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd.
requiredKnowledge: In this course, it is important to solve more problems in order to understand the theory and put it into practice. Moreover, since they are one by one, continuous efforts are required. Therefore, do not leave what you do not understand, so be sure to clear 1) check various reference books, 2) ask the teachers, 3) use the Mathematics Education Center. In this course, students use mathematical equations such as simultaneous linear equations, determinants, matrices, differentiation / integration, basics of complex numbers, and trigonometric functions.

activityGoals.body: To be able to analyze and establish circuit equations of R, L, C series and parallel circuits by symbolic method
To be able to calculate the phase condition problems of series and parallel circuits and basic problems of AC
To be able to calculate the problems of series and parallel resonant circuits using symbolic method
To be able to calculate the power problems using symbolic method

achievementLevels.ideal: At the end of the course, using the symbolic method, R-L, R-C, or R-L-C series and parallel circuit equations can be set up and analyzed. Using symbolic methods, you can solve from basic to applied problems of phase conditions, resonant circuits, AC power in series and parallel circuits.
achievementLevels.standard: At the end of the course, using the symbolic method, R-L, R-C, or R-L-C series and parallel circuit equations can be set up and analyzed. Using symbolic methods, you can solve phase condition problems in series and parallel circuits, basic problems in AC power, in series resonant circuits and in parallel resonant circuits.
